.representativeRow

Source: R/plotTopHeatmap.R
dot-representativeRow.Rd

Finds, for every region of a result table, the row of the counts that carries its statistic. On a tiled object that is the tile the combination picked, and on a non-tiled one it is the region itself.

Usage

.representativeRow(rowTable, topTable, results)

Arguments

rowTable

Data.frame with the rows of the counts and their positions.

topTable

Data.frame with the regions to draw.

results

RegionSetDE.results object.

Value

An integer vector with one position per region, NA when the region is absent from the counts.
